<js>
u = baseUrl;
if (/\/ml(\d+)\.html$/.test(u)) {
  n = parseInt(RegExp.$1) + 1;
  result = u.replace(/ml\d+\.html$/, 'ml' + n + '.html');
} else {
  result = u.replace(/\/$/, '') + '/ml1.html';

ruleContent.content:
<js>
h = java.ajax(baseUrl);
var m = h.match(/qsbs\.bb\('([^']+)'\)/g);
if (!m) { result = ''; }
else {
  var sb = new java.lang.StringBuilder();
  for (var i = 0; i < m.length; i++) {
    var b = m[i].match(/qsbs\.bb\('([^']+)'\)/)[1];
    sb.append(java.base64Decode(b));
  }
  var t = sb.toString();
  t = t.replace(/<script[\s\S]*?<\/script>/g, '').replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '');
  t = t.replace(/ /g, ' ').replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>');
  t = t.replace(/[ \t]+/g, ' ').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n');
  result = t.replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
}
</js>
